_comment: Copy this file to secrets.json (git-ignored). matrixPassword is required to unlock /members/matrix/ — in GitHub Actions, set it as the MATRIX_PASSWORD repository secret instead. The 'members' map is OPTIONAL: member portals default to the member's own memberId as the password (no per-member secret needed), so only add an entry here for a member you want to give a stronger, different password. See CLAUDE.md > Security.
